class.name: OcgGpLin
class.brief_description: Describes a line in 3D space. A line is positioned in space with an axis (a gp_Ax1 object) which gives it an origin and a unit vector. A line and an axis are similar objects, thus, we can convert one into the other. A line provides direct access to the majority of the edit and query functions available on its positioning axis. In addition, however, a line has specific functions for computing distances and positions. See Also gce_MakeLin which provides functions for more complex line constructions Geom_Line which provides additional functions for constructing lines and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of lines
class.description: ! Describes a line in 3D space. ! A line is positioned in space with an axis (a gp_Ax1 ! object) which gives it an origin and a unit vector. ! A line and an axis are similar objects, thus, we can ! convert one into the other. A line provides direct access ! to the majority of the edit and query functions available ! on its positioning axis. In addition, however, a line has ! specific functions for computing distances and positions. ! See Also ! gce_MakeLin which provides functions for more complex ! line constructions ! Geom_Line which provides additional functions for ! constructing lines and works, in particular, with the ! parametric equations of lines

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a Line corresponding to Z axis of the reference coordinate system.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a line defined by axis theA1.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a line passing through point theP and parallel to vector theV (theP and theV are, respectively, the origin and the unit vector of the positioning axis of the line).

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Reverses the direction of the line. Note: - Reverse assigns the result to this line, while - Reversed creates a new one.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: Changes the direction of the line.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the location point (origin) of the line.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Complete redefinition of the line. The "Location" point of <theA1> is the origin of the line. The "Direction" of <theA1> is the direction of the line.

method.name: Direction
method.description: Returns the direction of the line.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the location point (origin) of the line.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the axis placement one axis with the same location and direction as <me>.

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angle between two lines in radians.

method.name: Distance_1
method.description: Computes the distance between <me> and the point theP.

method.name: Distance_2
method.description: Computes the distance between two lines.

method.name: SquareDistance_1
method.description: Computes the square distance between <me> and the point theP.

method.name: SquareDistance_2
method.description: Computes the square distance between two lines.

method.name: Normal
method.description: Computes the line normal to the direction of <me>, passing through the point theP. Raises ConstructionError if the distance between <me> and the point theP is lower or equal to Resolution from gp because there is an infinity of solutions in 3D space.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a line with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a line with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a line with respect to a plane. The axis placement <theA2> locates the plane of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a line. A1 is the axis of the rotation. Ang is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a line. theS is the scaling value. The "Location" point (origin) of the line is modified. The "Direction" is reversed if the scale is negative.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a line with the transformation theT from class Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates a line in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates a line from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
